title: Besieged
caption: Besieged (V)
lore: Stormtroopers blasted through the main airlock of the _Tantive IV_. The Rebel soldiers’ attempt to defend the intrusion was no match for the Empire’s superior firepower.
game_text: Deploy on table. If opponent just forfeited a character or unpiloted starship at same system or sector as your Imperial capital starship, you may draw destiny. Character or starship is captured if destiny > its destiny number. {alter}
